mapper.select: SELECT code, name, location, description FROM station ORDER BY code
SELECT code, name, location, description FROM station WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT FROM observation WHERE station_code = #{code} ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM observation WHERE station_code = #{code} AND observed_at = #{time} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM observation WHERE ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(temperature), 2) AS average, MIN(temperature) AS minimum, MAX(temperature) AS maximum, COUNT(*) AS count FROM observation WHERE

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM observed_at) AS bucket_hour, CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM observed_at) / 15) * 15 AS SIGNED) AS bucket_minute, ROUND(AVG(), 2) AS `value`, COUNT() AS count FROM observation WHERE GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM observed_at), CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM observed_at) / 15) * 15 AS SIGNED) ORDER BY bucket_hour, bucket_minute

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM observed_at) AS `month`, ROUND(AVG(), 2) AS average, MIN() AS minimum, MAX() AS maximum, COUNT() AS count FROM observation WHERE GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM observed_at) ORDER BY `month`
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO observation(station_code, observed_at, temperature, humidity, solar_radiation, outdoor_temperature, wind_speed, source) VALUES (#{code}, #{r.observedAt}, #{r.temperature}, #{r.humidity}, #{r.solarRadiation}, #{r.outdoorTemperature}, #{r.windSpeed}, #{source}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
